changes.text: The clear button shows the base solid `--ss-primary` focus ring (was a `--ss-primary-soft` glow at about 1.5:1) and has a 24×24px minimum hit area (`--ss-s-6`); the glyph keeps its size.
The required marker `.req` uses `margin-inline-start`, so its spacing mirrors under `dir="rtl"`.
The `.clear` button honours the `hidden` attribute, so in plain HTML with `vanilla.js` the × no longer shows on an empty field.
Plain-HTML support: `dssoca/vanilla.css` styles the same markup and `dssoca/vanilla.js` wires the clear button.
The invalid focus glow is built from `--ss-danger` with `color-mix()` instead of the removed `--ss-red-rgb` token.
`hint` and `error` text under the field: both are linked through `aria-describedby`, and `error` also sets `aria-invalid` and is announced with `role="alert"`.
`prefix` and `suffix` snippets inside the field, and `clearable`, which renders a clear button while the field has a value and is not `readonly` or `disabled`.
`readonly`, `autocomplete`, `inputmode` and `maxlength` props; any other native input attribute or event handler is forwarded to the `<input>`.
Invalid (red border and focus glow), disabled and read-only styles, and a `*` marker in the label when `required` is set.

Markup changed: the root is always a `div.ss-field` (also without `label`) holding `label.lbl`, a `div.control` wrapper that now carries the border and focus ring, and the `input.ss-input`. Before, the root was a `<label class="ss-field">`, or a bare `<input>` when there was no label.
`size` prop (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) that overrides the global size for this field; the resolved value is set as `data-size-variant`.
The label is always associated with the input: an `id` is generated when none is passed.
Styles ship with the component (scoped) instead of living in `theme.css`.
Classes renamed from `hub-field` / `hub-input` to `ss-field` / `ss-input`, following the global `hub-` → `ss-` and `--hs-*` → `--ss-*` rename.
New component: a text field with an optional `label`, a bindable `value`, and `type`, `placeholder`, `required`, `disabled`, `id`, `name` and `oninput` props.
